articles.title: Washington Weighs Nvidia Fallout as China Concerns Grow
articles.description: The controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is raising broader national security questions in Washington, from the potential exposure of sensitive information to concerns over the company’s dealings in China. Foundation for American Innovation senior fellow Ryan Fedasiuk discusses the questions he believes an independent investigation should examine and why the episode could add momentum to bipartisan efforts to tighten controls on the flow of advanced US chips to China. He joins Riley Griffin on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Courts Should Employ a Simpler Fair Use Analysis for Noncompeting Criticism
articles.description: Copyright and trademark rights act in tension with the First Amendment. Indeed, “unlike other property rights, [these] are a form of content-based, government-imposed speech restriction.” (Mark Lemley and Eugene Volokh, Freedom of Speech and Injunctions in Intellectual Property Cases, 48 Duke L.J. 147, 206 (1998)). As such, courts have determined that criticism, generally, puts the critic beyond the reach of a copyright or trademark claim.
